subject: Clarify fee translation between Pricing Schedule and Invoice Metrics
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixcare.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixcare.com
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on pricing schedule fee translation

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks for sending the draft order schedule yesterday. Our procurement team is trying to reconcile the figures in Exhibit A (Pricing Schedule) with the invoice metric column your finance team will use. Two quick clarifications: 

- The "Token Equivalent" row — should that be applied to the gross monthly usage before any batching discounts?
- The floor/ceiling language in Exhibit A references "monthly chargeable units" but our AR team invoices on "billable tokens". Could you confirm the canonical metric Redwood will invoice on?

If we don't align the metric now there will be a mismatch in month 1 and that will complicate our internal True-Up. Would it be possible to get a short annotated version of Exhibit A that maps the lines to invoice fields?

Also looping in John from legal (CC) because he may request clearer definitions in the actual exhibit wording.

Appreciate it — Sara

--
Sara Patel
Head of Procurement, HelixCare
procurement@helixcare.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on pricing schedule fee translation

Sara — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front:

- Token Equivalent applies to pre-discount usage (gross) before batching/threshold discounts are applied.
- Redwood invoices on "billable tokens" (defined in the invoice appendix) which will equal post-batching token count but pre-application of monthly true-ups.

I'll attach an annotated PDF mapping each row in Exhibit A to the invoice field names and a one-page glossary. Legal (Kimberly) has been CC'd because she may want tighter exhibit language around "monthly chargeable units" -> suggestion below.

Next steps: I will send the annotated exhibit in the next email and propose a small wording tweak for the floor/ceiling lines that should address John's/your team's True-Up concerns. If HelixCare is open to a one-time reconciliation credit for month 1 in the event of an unavoidable delta, we can prototype that as a contingency.

Best,
Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-2299

Attachments: HelixCare_Pricing_Schedule_annotated.pdf

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixcare.com>, John D. <john.doe@helixcare.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing exhibit wording suggestion (internal redline)

Team — reviewing the annotated exhibit Mateo shared. A few legal redline suggestions to avoid ambiguity: 

1) Replace "monthly chargeable units" with "Monthly Billable Tokens (as defined below)" and add a definition: 
   - "Monthly Billable Tokens" means the total token count after continuous batching and prefix caching but prior to application of any end-of-month True-Up adjustments or one-time credits.
2) For the floor/ceiling clauses, suggest adding a parenthetical: 
   - "Floor: Minimum Monthly Billable Tokens (exclusive of discounts)" and likewise for Ceiling.
3) Add a brief reconciliation clause: 
   - "In the event of a billing metric variance exceeding 3% in Month 1 such variance will be reconciled via a one-time credit or debit reflected on the first subsequent invoice, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing."

These changes keep the economic intent but remove the invoicing ambiguity. Mateo — if we accept a 3% threshold for crediting, do we want to cap the credit ($) to the lesser of the delta or $10k for commercial prudence?

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-exhibit-redline.docx

From: John D. <john.doe@helixcare.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixcare.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing exhibit wording suggestion (HelixCare comments)

Kimberly / Mateo — quick note from HelixCare legal: we appreciate the clearer definitions. Two counterpoints: 

1) The proposed 3% variance threshold is reasonable, but we'd ask that the cap be tied to a percentage of monthly spend rather than a flat $10k (e.g., cap at 10% of the Month 1 invoice) to keep the remedy proportional for small pilots.
2) For invoicing transparency, please add an invoice appendix sample row showing: (a) gross token count, (b) batching adjustment, (c) billable tokens, (d) discounts, (e) final invoice amount. That will speed our AR reconciliation.

If Redwood is comfortable with a spend-proportional cap and the sample invoice row, we can proceed to DocuSign. I'll wait for the updated exhibit and the appendix example.

Thanks — John

--
John D.
Senior Counsel, HelixCare
john.doe@helixcare.com

Attachments: none

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: John D. <john.doe@helixcare.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2027 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized exhibit language + sample invoice row

John / Sara — thanks for the quick review. Per the thread we've updated Exhibit A and the invoice appendix with the sample row. Summary of what's changed: 

- "Monthly Billable Tokens" defined exactly as Kimberley suggested (post-batching, pre-true-up, pre-credit).
- Variance remedy: 3% threshold, credit capped at 10% of Month 1 invoice (HelixCare requested proportional cap; Redwood accepted that as a percent).
- Added a sample invoice row in the appendix showing: gross tokens / batching adjustment / billable tokens / discounts / invoice total.

Attached: HelixCare_Pricing_Schedule_annotated.pdf (annotated mapping) and pricing-exhibit-redline.docx (language redline).

Next steps: John — if wording looks good to you, we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and send. Mateo will follow up on the conditional one-time reconciliation procedure for ops.

If you want the cap to be a different percentage, flag it now — otherwise we'll proceed with 10% as discussed.

Best,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: HelixCare_Pricing_Schedule_annotated.pdf; pricing-exhibit-redline.docx
